name: erp_method
note: Realized geometric premium of the S&P 500 Total Return over a 10-year Treasury bond's total return (D7).

name: erp_first_year
note: First full calendar year of ^SP500TR on Yahoo; the window expands from here to the last year ended before the as-of date.

name: terminal_growth_method
note: Terminal growth equals the risk-free rate (DGS10) at the as-of date (D7).

name: terminal_method
note: Terminal value with new investment earning its cost of capital: NOPAT_Y5 × (1 + g) / WACC (Koller et al., Valuation, ch. 14). Chosen on the M4 decision card.
